config.segmentBasis: Three segments: Data Center (Instinct GPUs, EPYC server CPUs, NICs, data center FPGAs), Client and Gaming (Ryzen PC processors, Radeon graphics, game-console custom chips), and Embedded (FPGAs and embedded processors for industrial, auto and aerospace)
